description: Solid waste data of the Ministry of Local Administration is a data set listed in opendata.gov.jo, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Local Administration. A modern and integrated system based on the principles of reduce - reuse - recycle. Coverage: Jordan. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Local Administration. Its tags are solid waste. It offers 3 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Jordonian License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-jo-portal.
